title: Beary SMP Modpack
description: This Modpack lets you join the Beary SMP.
body:
This Modpack lets you join the BearySMP: Modded server made by the small streamer revvz0. The SMP gets regular updates, unique mods, and exciting events for all players. The server runs on Minecraft 1.20.1 with Forge, offering smooth gameplay and custom features.



🛡 Rules & Gameplay

- No griefing or PvP at spawn

- Respect other players

- No cheating or X-Ray usage



⚔️ Boss Events every week!

- Special bosses like Void Blossom and Obsidilith appear on separate servers for epic fights

- Unique kits are provided for each boss fight — ready to use, no preparation needed



🎒 Mods & Features

- Modded gameplay with The Aether, Stellarity, Alex's Mobs and more

- Custom mechanics for armor durability, mining, and combat enhancements

- Forge-based mods for smooth performance



🌐 Community & Server Info

- Friendly Discord community with events, voting for mods, and boss announcements

- Separate servers for special events to keep your main world safe

- Regular updates with new bosses, mods, and challenges



Join BearySMP to explore, fight bosses, collect unique loot, and become part of a growing modded community!


Discord: https://discord.gg/shqxvyTMZd
